title: Program Execution & Primitives
summary: This module defines the core building blocks and execution logic for DSPy programs, including foundational modules, data types, and mechanisms for tool and adapter integration.

nodes.label: Core Modules
nodes.title: Core Module Primitives
nodes.description: Defines the foundational `BaseModule` for parameter management and the `Module` class for program logic, LM interaction, and execution.

nodes.label: Data Types & Interfaces
nodes.title: Data Types and Interfaces
nodes.description: Provides core data structures and interfaces for interacting with Language Models (LMs), including request/response formats, streaming events, and configuration options.

nodes.label: Tool & Adapter Integration
nodes.title: Tool and Adapter Integration
nodes.description: Offers mechanisms for integrating external tools and defining custom adapters to interface with LMs, supporting multimodal interactions and structured data.

nodes.label: Prediction Modules
nodes.title: Prediction Modules
nodes.description: Provides various advanced prediction strategies and techniques, including aggregation methods, multi-turn reasoning agents, and program-of-thought execution.

nodes.label: Retrieval Modules
nodes.title: Retrieval Modules
nodes.description: Offers various retrieval mechanisms, including local and remote ColBERTv2 implementations, Databricks Vector Search, and Weaviate, to fetch relevant passages.

nodes.label: Program Optimization & Evaluation
nodes.title: Program Optimization and Evaluation
nodes.description: Encompasses modules for automated prompt engineering, few-shot example selection, program refinement, and evaluation metrics.

groups.label: Foundational Components
groups.title: Foundational Components
groups.description: These modules establish the basic structure, data handling, and external integration capabilities for all DSPy programs.

groups.label: Program Execution Strategies
groups.title: Program Execution Strategies
groups.description: These modules provide the core mechanisms for generating predictions and retrieving information within DSPy programs.

groups.label: Program Refinement
groups.title: Program Refinement
groups.description: This module focuses on improving the performance and efficiency of DSPy programs through various optimization and evaluation techniques.
